review_scope: Additive review of the follow-up provenance, precision-dependent skip handling, and contract wording. The production adapter was not re-reviewed beyond confirming its hash is unchanged from v1.

findings.detail: Generated fault-source manifest binds the original adapter hash, generated-file hashes, exact anchor text, one-based occurrence and anchor count, and injected fault description. Ambiguous anchor counts fail closed.

The default-REAL conversion-overflow case checks HUGE(default REAL) against HUGE(wp). If default REAL is not narrower, the Fortran fixture emits a dedicated skip marker and returns 77; Python accepts that only for this named case, and CTest maps 77 to SKIP_RETURN_CODE. Other fault cases still require their exact guard diagnostic and nonzero termination.
Documentation limits the check to fail-fast output validation and explicitly avoids claiming it fixes the separate thermodynamic failure or establishes forecast accuracy.

focused_validation.result: PASS: 11/11 CTest cases; zero model invocations
focused_validation.note: Read existing root-owned receipt and log only; this review did not run tests or builds.

limitations: This is a scoped follow-up review, not a second full review of adapter arithmetic or all original tests.
The overflow fault is skipped on configurations where default REAL is not narrower than wp; this is represented as a CTest skip, not a passing overflow-path execution.
